headline: Actress Samira Khan Mahi crowned Miss Universe Bangladesh 2026
summary: The television actress will represent Bangladesh at the 75th edition of the Miss Universe competition in Puerto Rico.
details: Television actress Samira Khan Mahi has been crowned Miss Universe Bangladesh 2026 at a ceremony held in Dhaka on Saturday.
Mahi was visibly emotional as she was crowned by the previous year’s winner, Tangia Zaman Methila, amidst loud applause from the audience.
The actress wore a champagne-gold, off-shoulder mermaid gown adorned with sparkling stones for the event.
The ceremony was attended by notable personalities including national director Mustafa Rafiqul Islam Duke, actress Dighi, and filmmaker Mehedi Hasan Hridoy.
Organisers confirmed that Mahi will now represent Bangladesh at the 75th edition of the Miss Universe competition in Puerto Rico.
Activities for the international pageant are scheduled to begin on November 11.
Mahi expressed her pride and gratitude on Facebook, describing the win as a responsibility bigger than herself and a moment for the entire country.
caption:
From the television screen to the global stage! – Samira Khan Mahi is the new Miss Universe Bangladesh 2026.

Television actress Samira Khan Mahi has been crowned Miss Universe Bangladesh 2026 at a ceremony held in Dhaka on Saturday.

Mahi was visibly emotional as she was crowned by the previous year’s winner, Tangia Zaman Methila, amidst loud applause from the audience.

The actress wore a champagne-gold, off-shoulder mermaid gown adorned with sparkling stones for the event.

The ceremony was attended by notable personalities including national director Mustafa Rafiqul Islam Duke, actress Dighi, and filmmaker Mehedi Hasan Hridoy.

Organisers confirmed that Mahi will now represent Bangladesh at the 75th edition of the Miss Universe competition in Puerto Rico.

Activities for the international pageant are scheduled to begin on November 11.

Mahi expressed her pride and gratitude on Facebook, describing the win as a responsibility bigger than herself and a moment for the entire country.

summary: Md Asaduzzaman says a request has been sent to India to return the ousted prime minister under the extradition treaty.
details: Law Minister Md Asaduzzaman has described ousted prime minister Sheikh Hasina as a "convicted criminal," stating that this is her identity according to the Bangladeshi tribunal.
